subject.title: fix(security): bound mcporter registry read in audit

question: Does the security code owner approve extending the audit’s existing unavailable-registry behavior to registries rejected by the 16 MiB and regular-file safety checks?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but the affected path is explicitly owned by the security team and determines how the audit handles an uninspectable security-relevant registry.

options.title: Approve bounded best-effort read
options.body: Accept the existing unavailable-source behavior for oversized or unsafe registries and merge this focused memory-exhaustion hardening.

options.title: Require separate diagnostic
options.body: Keep the cap but request a distinct audit finding when an existing registry cannot be safely inspected.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded best-effort read
recommendation.body: Accept the existing unavailable-source behavior for oversized or unsafe registries and merge this focused memory-exhaustion hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest individual history on the central audit module; the formal code-owner boundary is the OpenClaw security operations team.
